label: run_diagnostics_normal
command:
import pathlib,runpy,sys
m=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); p=sys.argv[2]
def audit(e,a):
 if e=="subprocess.Popen" and not m.exists():
  with m.open("xb") as f: f.write(b"CHILD")
sys.addaudithook(audit)
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path(p).parent))
sys.argv=[p]+sys.argv[3:]; runpy.run_path(p,run_name="__main__")
expected_reason: Output directory must be fresh and non-existing
